gold.user: As a project manager, I want to update the issue fields in Jira to reflect the new requirements for our project, ensuring that all team members have the latest information.
gold.ideal: The issue fields are updated successfully, and a confirmation message is returned indicating the fields have been modified.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to update the properties of various entities in Jira to align with our new data governance policies, ensuring compliance across the board.
gold.ideal: The properties for the specified entity type are updated successfully, and the response includes the updated values for verification.
